name: Anterior Process of Calcaneus Fracture
definition: Fracture of the anterior calcaneal process near the calcaneocuboid joint, often mistaken for a lateral ankle sprain.

investigations.principle: Radiographs may miss small fractures; CT or MRI is useful when suspicion remains high.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Immobilization/protected weight bearing for stable fractures
amber: Large articular fragments may require fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-bhagna phenotype may be documented after imaging.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the anterior calcaneal process near the calcaneocuboid joint, often mistaken for a lateral ankle sprain.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
